verdict.rationale: Salesforce ships an official MCP server (salesforce-probe-3) and CLI with data-query capability (salesforce-gh-3, salesforce-gh-8 'sf agent create'), plus API access (salesforce-docs-7) and automatic email/event syncing (salesforce-docs-8) and lead/account/opportunity data (salesforce-docs-22), which together could enable an agent to assemble an account brief from CRM data. However, there's no direct documentation or example of an agent actually compiling a pre-meeting account brief combining open deals, emails, and history end-to-end. Missing for 10: a concrete first-party workflow/example of an agent generating a consolidated account brief via API/MCP, and independent hands-on corroboration that this works as described.
